params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"
MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY systemId ORDER BY SystemModifiedAt DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.systemId = D.systemId

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.systemModifiedAt IS NULL OR D.systemModifiedAt > T.systemModifiedAt
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  entryNumber                 = D.entryNumber,
  itemNumber                  = D.itemNumber,
  locationCode                = D.locationCode,
  variantCode                 = D.variantCode,
  quantity                    = D.quantity,
  `Latest_Valuation_Date`     = D.`Latest_Valuation_Date`,
  itemLedgerEntryNumber       = D.itemLedgerEntryNumber,
  `Item_Register_No`          = D.`Item_Register_No`,
  systemCreatedAt             = D.systemCreatedAt,
  systemCreatedBy             = D.systemCreatedBy,
  systemModifiedAt            = D.systemModifiedAt,
  systemModifiedBy            = D.systemModifiedBy,
  postingDate                 = D.postingDate,
  transferredFromEntryNumber  = D.transferredFromEntryNumber,
  creationDate                = D.creationDate,
  createdByUser               = D.createdByUser,
  lastModifiedDate            = D.lastModifiedDate,
  lastModifiedByUser          = D.lastModifiedByUser,
  inboundItemEntryNumber      = D.inboundItemEntryNumber,
  outboundItemEntryNumber     = D.outboundItemEntryNumber,
  costApplication             = D.costApplication,
  outputCompletelyInvdDate    = D.outputCompletelyInvdDate,
  outboundEntryIsUpdated      = D.outboundEntryIsUpdated

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
INSERT (
  entryNumber,
  itemNumber,
  locationCode,
  variantCode,
  quantity,
  `Latest_Valuation_Date`,
  itemLedgerEntryNumber,
  `Item_Register_No`,
  systemId,
  systemCreatedAt,
  systemCreatedBy,
  systemModifiedAt,
  systemModifiedBy,
  postingDate,
  transferredFromEntryNumber,
  creationDate,
  createdByUser,
  lastModifiedDate,
  lastModifiedByUser,
  inboundItemEntryNumber,
  outboundItemEntryNumber,
  costApplication,
  outputCompletelyInvdDate,
  outboundEntryIsUpdated
)
VALUES (
  D.entryNumber,
  D.itemNumber,
  D.locationCode,
  D.variantCode,
  D.quantity,
  D.`Latest_Valuation_Date`,
  D.itemLedgerEntryNumber,
  D.`Item_Register_No`,
  D.systemId,
  D.systemCreatedAt,
  D.systemCreatedBy,
  D.systemModifiedAt,
  D.systemModifiedBy,
  D.postingDate,
  D.transferredFromEntryNumber,
  D.creationDate,
  D.createdByUser,
  D.lastModifiedDate,
  D.lastModifiedByUser,
  D.inboundItemEntryNumber,
  D.outboundItemEntryNumber,
  D.costApplication,
  D.outputCompletelyInvdDate,
  D.outboundEntryIsUpdated
)
"
